description: Shows a value, such as a reference number, an API key or a link, with a button that copies it to the clipboard and confirms it.

inputs.name: Label
inputs.description: A label above the value. Empty shows none.

inputs.name: CopiedLabel
inputs.description: Shown on the button for two seconds after a copy, and announced to screen readers.

events.name: OnCopied
events.description: Raised after the value was copied to the clipboard.

modifiers.description: Smaller text and padding, for tables and dense forms.
